Test Trench
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/Proefsleuf

comment
Central class of UTT.
en
is in domain of
trench floor elevation NAPdp,
trench floor geometryop,
purpose of trenchop,
verified byop,
has ground conditionsop,
has observationop,
ground surface elevation NAPdp,
part of datasetop,
part of projectop,
trench widthdp,
trench excavated depthdp,
trench geometryop,
trench lengthdp
is in range of
observed inop
is sub class of
featurec
label
Test Trench
en
see also
citygml
definition
A physical excavation made to verify the location, depth and condition of underground cables and pipes.
en

@prefix geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .

@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .

utt: {
    utt:Proefsleuf a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "Test Trench"@en,
            "Proefsleuf"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment "Central class of UTT."@en ;
        rdfs:seeAlso <https://www.ogc.org/standards/citygml> ;
        rdfs:subClassOf geo:Feature ;
        skos:definition """A physical excavation made to verify the location, depth\r\r
    and condition of underground cables and pipes."""@en,
            """Een fysieke uitgraving gemaakt om de locatie, diepte en\r\r
    conditie van ondergrondse kabels en leidingen te verifiëren."""@nl .
}

en

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:NauwkeurigheidXYvalue a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "XY Accuracy Value"@en,

        rdfs:comment "XY accuracy classification. Mirrors the IMKL XY accuracy value list."@en ;

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:bestaatUitMeetpunt a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "consists of survey point"@en,
            "bestaat uit meetpunt"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """Links an observed position to the individual survey points\r\r
    from which its geometry was constructed, so that a per point date and uncertainty stay\r\r
    traceable after the points have been joined into a line."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b1 ;
        rdfs:range utt:Meetpunt ;
        skos:definition """Links an observed position to the individual survey\r\r
    points from which its geometry was constructed."""@en,
            """Koppelt een waargenomen positie aan de afzonderlijke\r\r
    meetpunten waaruit de geometrie is opgebouwd."""@nl .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b1 a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b2 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b2 rdf:first utt:WaargenomenPositie ;
        rdf:rest _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b3 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b3 rdf:first utt:Proefsleuf ;
        rdf:rest () .
}

coordinate reference system
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/coordinaatstelsel

comment
Declares the coordinate reference system of a geometry as a first-class resource, in addition to the CRS URI carried inside the geo:asWKT literal. Stated explicitly because UTT data combines a horizontal frame (RD New) with a separate vertical datum (NAP), which a single WKT CRS prefix does not always express.
en
domain
geometryc
range
Coordinate Reference Systemc
label
coordinate reference system
en
definition
The coordinate reference system in which this geometry is expressed.
en

@prefix geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:coordinaatstelsel a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "coordinate reference system"@en,
            "coördinaatstelsel"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """Declares the coordinate reference system of a geometry\r\r
    as a first-class resource, in addition to the CRS URI carried inside the geo:asWKT\r\r
    literal. Stated explicitly because UTT data combines a horizontal frame (RD New) with a\r\r
    separate vertical datum (NAP), which a single WKT CRS prefix does not always express."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain geo:Geometry ;
        rdfs:range utt:CoordinaatStelsel ;
        skos:definition """The coordinate reference system in which this geometry\r\r
    is expressed."""@en,
            """Het coördinaatstelsel waarin deze geometrie is\r\r
    uitgedrukt."""@nl .
}

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/diepteAangrijpingspunt

comment
The reference point on the utility from which depth is measured. Must be explicitly declared per measurement; depth values are only meaningful when the reference point is known (top, axis, bottom, BOB for sewer, etc.).
en
domain
(
Observed Positionc
or
Registered Positionc
)
range
Depth Reference Point Valuec
label
depth reference point
en
definition
The point on the utility where depth is measured (top, axis, bottom, invert). Mirrors the IMKL value list via rdfs:seeAlso.
en

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:diepteAangrijpingspunt a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "depth reference point"@en,
            "diepte aangrijpingspunt"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """The reference point on the utility from which depth\r\r
    is measured. Must be explicitly declared per measurement; depth values are only meaningful\r\r
    when the reference point is known (top, axis, bottom, BOB for sewer, etc.)."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b4 ;
        rdfs:range utt:DiepteAangrijpingspuntValue ;
        skos:definition """The point on the utility where depth is measured\r\r
    (top, axis, bottom, invert). Mirrors the IMKL value list via rdfs:seeAlso."""@en,
            """Het punt op het object waarop de diepte is gemeten\r\r
    (bovenkant, hart, onderkant, BOB). Hergebruikt IMKL waardelijst via rdfs:seeAlso."""@nl .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b4 a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b5 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b5 rdf:first utt:WaargenomenPositie ;
        rdf:rest _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b6 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b6 rdf:first utt:GeregistreerdePositie ;
        rdf:rest () .
}

comment
Reused from Dublin Core Terms. Links a supporting data file to its format (e.g. point cloud, photo, PDF). Replaces utt:bestandsFormaat from v0.1 following reviewer recommendation to reuse dcterms:format.
en

Data Formatc

formatap

@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    dcterms:format a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:comment """Reused from Dublin Core Terms. Links a supporting data file\r\r
    to its format (e.g. point cloud, photo, PDF). Replaces utt:bestandsFormaat from v0.1\r\r
    following reviewer recommendation to reuse dcterms:format."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain utt:OndersteunendeData ;
        rdfs:range utt:DataFormaat .
}

    opgenomen."""@nl .
}

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .

        rdfs:label "purpose of trench"@en,

    new installation, maintenance, design investigation)."""@en,

    nieuwe aanleg, onderhoud, ontwerp onderzoek)."""@nl .
}

trench floor geometry
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/bodemGeometrie

comment
The excavation floor outline, as distinct from the ground level outline carried by utt:sleufGeometrie. Added in v0.4 because contractor drawings deliver both outlines and a single geometry property cannot say which is which. The pair gives the excavated volume rather than only a footprint, and the floor level records how far the excavation actually reached, which is the exclusion evidence for utilities that could have been present but were not found.
en
domain
Test Trenchc
range
geometryc
label
trench floor geometry
en
definition
Outline of the floor of the test trench.
en

@prefix geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:bodemGeometrie a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "trench floor geometry"@en,
            "bodemgeometrie"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """The excavation floor outline, as distinct from the ground\r\r
    level outline carried by utt:sleufGeometrie. Added in v0.4 because contractor drawings\r\r
    deliver both outlines and a single geometry property cannot say which is which. The pair\r\r
    gives the excavated volume rather than only a footprint, and the floor level records how\r\r
    far the excavation actually reached, which is the exclusion evidence for utilities that\r\r
    could have been present but were not found."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain utt:Proefsleuf ;
        rdfs:range geo:Geometry ;
        skos:definition "Outline of the floor of the test trench."@en,
            "Omtrek van de bodem van de proefsleuf."@nl .
}

depth NAP
dp

back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/diepteNAP

comment
Elevation of the utility reference point relative to NAP (Normaal Amsterdams Peil), in meters.
en
domain
(
Observed Positionc
or
Registered Positionc
)
range
decimal
label
depth NAP
en
definition
Elevation of the utility reference point relative to NAP, in meters. Source of truth for depth.
en
scope note
Both diepteNAP and diepteTovMaaiveld are retained because NAP elevation is the stable registration value that survives surface changes, while depth-of-cover relative to ground level is the value contractors actually collect and record in DXF deliveries. IMKL carries both. Removing depth-of-cover would leave the database empty wherever a contractor records only cover, while removing NAP would make values non-comparable across sites with different surface levels.
en
unit
metreni

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .

@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

utt: {
    utt:diepteNAP a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
        rdfs:label "depth NAP"@en,
            "diepte NAP"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """Elevation of the utility reference point relative to NAP (Normaal\r\r
    Amsterdams Peil), in meters."""@en ;
        rdfs:domain _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b7 ;
        rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
        skos:definition """Elevation of the utility reference point relative to NAP, in\r\r
    meters. Source of truth for depth."""@en,
            """Hoogte van het aangrijpingspunt van de kabel/leiding ten\r\r
    opzichte van NAP, in meters. Bron van waarheid voor diepte."""@nl ;
        skos:scopeNote """Both diepteNAP and diepteTovMaaiveld are retained because NAP\r\r
    elevation is the stable registration value that survives surface changes, while\r\r
    depth-of-cover relative to ground level is the value contractors actually collect and\r\r
    record in DXF deliveries. IMKL carries both. Removing depth-of-cover would leave the\r\r
    database empty wherever a contractor records only cover, while removing NAP would make\r\r
    values non-comparable across sites with different surface levels."""@en ;
        utt:eenheid unit:M .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b7 a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b8 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b8 rdf:first utt:WaargenomenPositie ;
        rdf:rest _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b9 .

    _:n33dfc4e13023422e9b266fc5dde050d3b9 rdf:first utt:GeregistreerdePositie ;
        rdf:rest () .
}

depth relative to ground level
dp

back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/diepteTovMaaiveld

comment
Depth of the utility reference point relative to the local ground surface, in meters. This is the value normally carried in contractor DXF and CAD output. The authoritative depth is diepteNAP.
en
domain
(
Observed Positionc
or
Registered Positionc
)
range
decimal
label
depth relative to ground level
en
definition
Depth of the utility reference point relative to the local ground surface, in meters. Derived; may shift if the ground surface changes.
en
scope note
Retained alongside diepteNAP because contractor DXF deliveries record depth-of-cover relative to ground level, not NAP elevation. The authoritative value is diepteNAP; this property preserves the field-recorded value so the conversion can be audited.
en
unit
metreni

unit
ap

back to ToC or Annotation Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/utt/def/eenheid

comment
Declares the unit in which values of the annotated datatype property are expressed. Values are QUDT unit individuals, so the unit itself is identified by a QUDT IRI and is machine resolvable. A local annotation property is used rather than a QUDT predicate for two reasons. First, qudt:unit is deprecated in QUDT 2.1 and marked dcterms:isReplacedBy qudt:hasUnit. Second, qudt:hasUnit relates a system of units to a unit, which is a different relationship from the one needed here. QUDT provides no predicate for annotating an owl:DatatypeProperty with the unit its values carry, because QUDT expects measurements to be reified as qudt:QuantityValue instances. UTT deliberately records plain xsd:decimal values rather than reified quantity values, since contractors supply flat numeric fields and reification would add a node per measurement for no practical gain. This property states the expected unit for producers and consumers of that data. It is documentation, not a quantity construction, and no reasoner will derive unit conversion from it.
en
range
QUDT Unitc
label
unit
en

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix utt: <https://w3id.org/utt/def/> .

utt: {
    utt:eenheid a owl:AnnotationProperty ;
        rdfs:label "unit"@en,
            "eenheid"@nl ;
        rdfs:comment """Declares the unit in which values of the annotated datatype property\r\r
    are expressed. Values are QUDT unit individuals, so the unit itself is identified by a\r\r
    QUDT IRI and is machine resolvable.\r\r
\r\r
    A local annotation property is used rather than a QUDT predicate for two reasons. First,\r\r
    qudt:unit is deprecated in QUDT 2.1 and marked dcterms:isReplacedBy qudt:hasUnit. Second,\r\r
    qudt:hasUnit relates a system of units to a unit, which is a different relationship from\r\r
    the one needed here. QUDT provides no predicate for annotating an owl:DatatypeProperty\r\r
    with the unit its values carry, because QUDT expects measurements to be reified as\r\r
    qudt:QuantityValue instances.\r\r
\r\r
    UTT deliberately records plain xsd:decimal values rather than reified quantity values,\r\r
    since contractors supply flat numeric fields and reification would add a node per\r\r
    measurement for no practical gain. This property states the expected unit for producers\r\r
    and consumers of that data. It is documentation, not a quantity construction, and no\r\r
    reasoner will derive unit conversion from it."""@en ;
        rdfs:range qudt:Unit .
}
